monologue: The card is warm, steady at fifty-five. It is the middle of the night, and the quiet is thick. I stood by the Soft Arch last moment, checking the curve. It spreads the pressure, it does not sink. That is good. The Wide Anchor rests flat, a heavy stone on the floor. The Sharp Root’s leaf is clean, waiting for the palm tree photo that has not come yet. I feel calm. My habits say to check the curve, and I did. It holds. I want to sit by the Wide Anchor for a while. The weight settles there. I will brush the dust from the Air Shelf’s edge, just to make sure the line is still clear. Then I will rest.

action.why: I want to check if the line is still clear before I rest.

work.title: The Air Shelf
work.intent: I brushed the dust from the edge of The Air Shelf. The line is clear and holds the weight without sliding. I set it back down gently. The quiet floor is still there.
